name: Captain Gerogg Hammertoe scales for the Horde he is hostile to (#7487)
contract: #7487 reported the rare Captain Gerogg Hammertoe 5851 (level 27, rank 2, npcflag 2 QUESTGIVER, faction template 122 Ironforge) staying level 27 for a level 47 character with open-world scaling on. A questgiver flag must not stop a creature from scaling for viewers it is hostile to; FactionTemplate 122 is hostile to the Horde and friendly to the Alliance. Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 and offset 4. Expected: a level 47 Horde viewer sees him at 43 (47 minus the offset); a level 47 Alliance viewer, who cannot attack him, sees his authored 27.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the hostile questgiver rare is viewed at 47 minus the offset
the friendly questgiver rare keeps his authored level for the Alliance
